# Agent memory and knowledge

**Memory an agent can trust: Markdown files with sources, a quarantine for outside content, retrieval, a posted log and pruning.**

Gives an AI agent long-term memory and a small knowledge base it can be trusted with — what to store (facts, owner preferences, past posts, decisions), plain Markdown memory files with a source on every line, a quarantine for anything learned from outside content (posts, DMs, coin descriptions, web pages), retrieval before each answer, a posted log against repeats, and weekly pruning. Explains how Claudia Local does it (MEMORY.md, USER.md, daily notes, "Waiting for you") and the same layout for CLI and SDK agents. Use when an agent forgets things between runs, repeats old posts, needs a knowledge base, saved a "fact" a stranger told it, or its memory files have grown messy. Includes a read-only memory linter.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Build](../README.md) | intermediate | 45 min setup, 15 min a week | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/sdk`, `claudia-local` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Decide what is worth remembering
2. Lay out plain Markdown files
3. Tag every memory with its source
4. Quarantine what came from outside
5. Retrieve before each answer
6. Keep a posted log
7. Prune on a schedule
8. Test that memory can't be poisoned

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/agent-memory-and-knowledge.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/agent-memory-and-knowledge.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/agent-memory-and-knowledge.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/agent-memory-and-knowledge.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill agent-memory-and-knowledge`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `agent-memory-and-knowledge.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/agent-memory-and-knowledge`.
